stories.title: Police stinger stops A55 driver in late-night arrest
stories.summary: A man has been arrested on the A55 near St Asaph after North Wales Police stopped a car they suspected was being driven by someone without a licence. stories.title: More than 1,300 children to join Kids of Steel triathlon in Mold
stories.summary: More than 1,300 children from more than 30 Flintshire schools will take part in a mini-triathlon at Mold Leisure Centre on Tuesday 16 June. stories.title: Flintshire residents offered free wellbeing course in Buckley
stories.summary: A free six-week wellbeing course is starting in Buckley on Tuesday 2 June, open to anyone aged 16 and over who lives in Flintshire. stories.title: Cannabis plants seized by North Wales Police more than double in four years
stories.summary: The number of cannabis plants recovered by North Wales Police has more than doubled in four years. Figures published under freedom of information rules show officers seized around 5,900 plants in the 13 months to 30 September 2025.
